activities.name: The Shanghai Museum East (Main Permanent Collection)
activities.address: 1952 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area (B1 East Gate near Dingxiang Rd)
activities.exceptions: Closed Tuesdays (except national holidays — CLOSED Tue Feb 16, 2027! OPEN Mon Feb 15, 2027!)
activities.couple_cost_display: Free general entry (RMB 0 for 2; special exhibitions ticketed separately)
activities.booking_rule: No advance reservation required for individual general admission — bring original US passports at B1 East Gate. Curio-City & Digital Gallery require separate online reservation.
activities.metro_route: Line 2 Shanghai Science & Technology Museum Exit 8 / Line 4 Xiangcheng Rd Exit 2 (~22–28 min from Bund/Xintiandi)

activities.name: The Shanghai Museum on People's Square
activities.address: 201 Ren Min Da Dao, Huangpu (South Entrance Gate on Wusheng Rd)
activities.exceptions: Closed Mondays (CLOSED Mon Feb 15 & Mon Feb 22, 2027!). CRITICAL: From Jul 9, 2026 – Nov 14, 2027, hosts ONLY 'Ancient Civilizations of the Americas' — all permanent Chinese galleries are at Shanghai Museum East.
activities.couple_cost_display: — (Ticketed Americas exhibition; 2027 price unstated on English visitor page)
activities.booking_rule: Overseas visitors book via Trip.com or official WeChat Mini Program; bring original passport.
activities.metro_route: Line 1 / Line 2 / Line 8 People's Square Exit 1 or Line 14 Dashijie Exit 4 (~8–12 min from Xintiandi / Bund)

activities.name: Yu Garden (Yuyuan Classical Ming Garden — Daytime)
activities.address: North Gate: 168 Fuyou Rd · South Gate: 279 Yuyuan Old St, Huangpu
activities.exceptions: Closed every Monday (except statutory holidays — CLOSED Mon Feb 15, 2027! Spring Festival / Lantern Festival Sat Feb 20 hours subject to park notice).
activities.couple_cost_display: CNY 60 for 2 (Off-peak Dec 1 – Mar 31: CNY 30/adult; Peak Apr–Jun & Sep–Nov: CNY 40/adult)
activities.booking_rule: Purchase via '上海豫园' WeChat Mini Program or North/South Gate ticket windows with passport.
activities.metro_route: Line 10 / Line 14 Yuyuan Garden Station (~8–12 min from Xintiandi or Bund)

activities.name: Yuyuan Garden Night Tour ('Yu Xiang Shan Lin') & Lantern Festival
activities.exceptions: Closed Mon–Thu evenings in Jan–Apr except public holidays. Sat Feb 20, 2027 is Lantern Festival (15th day of Lunar New Year) — expect peak Yuyuan Mall Lantern Fair crowds.
activities.couple_cost_display: — (2025 Gov release cited CNY 150–218/pp = CNY 300–436 for 2; 2027 tariff unconfirmed)
activities.booking_rule: Timed-batch entry via 'yu-garden' WeChat account or South Gate ticket office.
activities.metro_route: Line 10 / Line 14 Yuyuan Garden Station (~8–12 min from Xintiandi / Bund)

activities.name: The Bund Waterfront Promenade & Heritage Architecture Walk
